title: As if, as though, suppose, imagine
summary: So sánh với điều không có thật: as if/as though + quá khứ (lùi thì), suppose/imagine/what if để đặt giả thiết.

dialogue.en: Why is Nam acting [[as if]] he [[were]] the boss?
dialogue.vi: Sao Nam cư xử như thể cậu ấy là sếp vậy?

dialogue.en: He talks [[as though]] he [[had built]] the company himself!
dialogue.vi: Cậu ấy nói như thể tự tay xây dựng công ty!
Giả sử cậu ấy thành quản lý thật. Lúc đó thì sao?
Thử tưởng tượng ngày nào cũng làm cho cậu ấy xem!

dialogue.en: It looks [[as if]] it's going to happen, though.
dialogue.vi: Nhưng có vẻ chuyện đó sắp xảy ra thật.

dialogue.en: Then it's high time I [[updated]] my CV.
dialogue.vi: Vậy đến lúc mình cập nhật CV rồi.

sections.heading: As if / as though + quá khứ
sections.rule: Khi so sánh với điều **không có thật**, sau **as if / as though** lùi thì: hiện tại → **quá khứ (were)**, quá khứ → **had + V3**.

formula.text: S + V + [as if] + S2 + V2 / were

examples.vi: Anh ấy nói như thể biết hết mọi thứ.

examples.en: She looked at me [[as though]] I [[were]] crazy.
examples.vi: Cô ấy nhìn tôi như thể tôi bị điên.
Anh ấy cư xử như thể chưa có chuyện gì.
examples.why: Chuyện đã xảy ra → had happened.

check.prompt: She spends money as if she ___ a millionaire.

sections.heading: Looks / sounds as if + thì bình thường
sections.rule: Khi điều đó **có thể đúng** (có dấu hiệu), sau **look / sound / seem as if** dùng **thì bình thường**.

examples.en: It looks [[as if]] it's going to rain.
examples.why: Có dấu hiệu thật → thì bình thường.

examples.en: You sound [[as if]] you have a cold.
examples.vi: Nghe giọng bạn như bị cảm.

check.prompt: Look at those clouds. It looks as if it ___ to snow.
check.explain: Có dấu hiệu thật → is going.

sections.heading: Suppose, supposing, imagine, what if
sections.rule: **Suppose / Supposing / Imagine / What if + quá khứ** = giả sử (khó xảy ra). Với **hiện tại** = khả năng thật.

examples.en: [[Suppose]] you [[lost]] your job. What would you do?
examples.vi: Giả sử bạn mất việc, bạn sẽ làm gì?
Lỡ mai trời mưa thì sao?
Thử tưởng tượng sống trên thuyền xem!

check.prompt: Supposing you ___ a million dollars, what would you buy?
check.explain: Giả sử khó xảy ra → won.

mistakes.wrong: He talks as if he is the owner, but he isn't.
mistakes.right: He talks as if he were the owner, but he isn't.

mistakes.wrong: She looked as though she has seen a ghost.
mistakes.right: She looked as though she had seen a ghost.
mistakes.why: Quá khứ không thật → had seen.

mistakes.wrong: Suppose you will meet the president.
It looks as if it were raining soon.
mistakes.right: It looks as if it's going to rain soon.
mistakes.why: Có dấu hiệu thật → thì bình thường.

exercises.prompt: He behaves as if he ___ my father.
She talked as though she ___ there herself, but she hadn't.
exercises.explain: Quá khứ không thật → had been.

exercises.prompt: Supposing the train ___ late, what would we do?
exercises.explain: Giả thiết khó xảy ra → were.

exercises.prompt: It sounds as if they ___ a great time. You can hear them laughing.
exercises.explain: Có dấu hiệu thật → thì bình thường.

exercises.prompt: Câu nào nói điều KHÔNG có thật?
options: He looks as if he is tired.
He talks as if he were a doctor.

exercises.prompt: Don't treat me as if I ___ a child.
He looked as if he ___ for days.
exercises.explain: Quá khứ không thật → had + V3.

exercises.prompt: What ___ we miss the last bus?

exercises.vi: Anh ấy nói như thể anh ấy biết hết.
Giả sử bạn mất ví thì sao?

exercises.sentence: She acts as if she is the queen.
answers: She acts as if she were the queen.

exercises.sentence: He spoke as though he has won the lottery.
answers: He spoke as though he had won the lottery.
exercises.explain: Quá khứ không thật → had won.

exercises.vi: Cô ấy nhìn tôi như thể tôi là người lạ.
answers: She looked at me as if I were a stranger.
She looked at me as though I were a stranger.
She looked at me as if I was a stranger.
She looked at me as though I was a stranger.
She looked at me like I was a stranger.

exercises.vi: Giả sử bạn được chọn bất kỳ công việc nào, bạn sẽ chọn gì?
answers: Suppose you could choose any job, what would you choose?
Supposing you could choose any job, what would you choose?
Suppose you could choose any job, which would you choose?
Imagine you could choose any job. What would you choose?
If you could choose any job, what would you choose?
